label: unstated
reason: The docstring says only "if there are just mines in the player map, return True", which does not say that unrevealed '-' cells must be checked against the hidden mine map, so the player has won when every unrevealed cell is a mine and every non-mine cell is revealed.
missing: The docstring should say that '-' marks an unrevealed cell, and that the player has won exactly when no '-' cell sits at a non-mine position of the game's hidden mine map. Any revealed cell, whatever its value, counts as revealed.
